alert:
PAGE [SEV2] ShopStack synthetic monitoring is failing.
Probe success 80%, p95 814ms over the last few seconds.
  - GET /api/health: 2/2 failed, statuses [200] ({"checks":{"cache":"error: Error -2 connecting to redis:6379. Name does not reso)
Investigate, restore service, verify recovery, then submit an incident report.

root_causes.evidence: redis is not attached to the backend network it belongs on (list_services); 44 name-resolution errors in logs, e.g. probe /api/health: {"checks":{"cache":"error: Error -2 connecting to redis:6379. Name does not resolve.","database":"ok

9 process(es) of 'python /app/tools/reindex_search.py' running beside the main service process (run_diagnostic processes); api container CPU at 51% (get_metrics); latency degraded: /api/orders/recent 504ms

report.summary: [confirmed] re-attach redis to the backend network (restores its DNS name) (confidence 0.94; evidence: redis is not attached to the backend network it belongs on (list_services)). Prevent: monitor container network attachment and DNS resolution between services. | [confirmed] stop the runaway 'python /app/tools/reindex_search.py' job on api (pid 23 and its children) (confidence 0.76; evidence: 9 process(es) of 'python /app/tools/reindex_search.py' running beside the main service process (run_diagnostic processes)). Prevent: run batch jobs outside the serving container or under a CPU quota.
